title: pilea muscosa var. microphylla
intro: Pilea muscosa var. microphylla, commonly known as Pilea, is a type of flowering plant in the Urticaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Pilea include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Pilea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and anti-cancer properties.
